## Summary

## Review Confidence

Least confident areas: checksum computation edge cases, heapless Vec capacity exhaustion paths.

- Explicit flow_label validation (20-bit limit enforcement)
- No unsafe code (forbid(unsafe_code))
- Proper use of heapless for no_std compatibility"}
